title: Leftover-Balance Relief on Home Comfort Financing Post-Promotional Interest
content:
*Rate desk guidance — Home Comfort Financing, interest after a promotion ends.*

The post-promotional leftover relief measures the amount financed less every payment that stood, a payment standing when it was not returned, in units of the account's monthly payment: it is 20 percent when that measure is at most one, 10 percent when it is above one but at most three, and zero when it is above three.

**Measuring the leftover.**

1. *Payments that stood* — every payment posted on the account since funding, less the amount of every returned payment.
2. *Leftover* — the amount financed less the payments that stood.
3. *Measure* — the leftover divided by the account's monthly payment, unrounded.

| Leftover, in monthly payments | Post-promotional leftover relief |
|---|---|
| at most 1 | 20 percent |
| above 1, at most 3 | 10 percent |
| above 3 | zero |

The relief is one of the post-promotional reliefs; they are added together into the post-promotional relief percentage, and the plan's post-promotional APR is reduced once by that total, never one relief after another.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts, monthly payment $166.80)

- Amount financed $3000.00; payments of $2850.00 posted, of which $166.80 was returned. Payments that stood: $2683.20. Leftover: $316.80, which is 1.899… monthly payments — above 1, at most 3: 10 percent.
- Amount financed $3000.00; payments that stood $2900.00. Leftover $100.00, 0.599… monthly payments — at most 1: 20 percent.
- Amount financed $3000.00; payments that stood $2499.60. Leftover $500.40, exactly 3 monthly payments — at most 3: 10 percent.
- Amount financed $3000.00; payments that stood $2000.00. Leftover $1000.00, 5.99… monthly payments — above 3: zero.

The leftover is measured from the amount financed and the payments alone; interest and fees on the account do not enter it.
